description: Restructures an existing table in one call. action=insert_rows needs row_index (+optional below, default true, and count 1-20); insert_columns needs column_index (+optional right, default true, and count); delete_row needs row_index and delete_column needs column_index — deletion permanently discards the cells' content, and the remaining rows/columns shift so indexes change between successive edits (re-check with list_slides). Cell TEXT is written with set_text/insert_text (row_index + column_index), not here.

below.description: insert_rows: insert below the reference row (default true; false = above).

presentation_id.description: The presentation id — the long id from the URL (docs.google.com/presentation/d/<presentationId>/edit) or from create_presentation output.

right.description: insert_columns: insert to the right of the reference column (default true; false = left).

table_object_id.description: The table's object id (type "table" in list_slides).

name: edit_table
title: Edit table structure
